brand.name: City Graphics
brand.tagline: Your Portland print shop, downtown since 1996.
brand.voice: Plain-spoken and reassuring, like a production pro across the counter. It says 'you' and 'we', gives exact specs honestly (13×19½″ sheets, 51-inch long sheets) and explains print jargon in plain words. Short, practical sentences such as 'Tell us what you're making — we'll help you get it printed right.' No hype and no promised outcomes.
brand.audience: Portland-area businesses, marketers, companies and nonprofits that need printing, mailing or trade show work, including people who are new to printing.
brand.typeDirection: Display: Archivo Variable at black weight in a condensed width, set in sentence case with tight leading, in off-white, like the site's hero headline. Kickers and section labels: Archivo bold in small uppercase with wide letter-spacing, in amber #ffb81c. Body: Archivo regular at normal width. Buttons are solid amber blocks with near-black bold text. Use a thin cyan / magenta / yellow / near-black rule as the recurring graphic divider, as in the site's nav bar.

copy.headline: Your Portland print shop, downtown since 1996.
copy.body: City Graphics is a single source for your marketing, printing, mailing and trade show needs. Tell us what you're making — we'll help you get it printed right.

copy.headline: Not sure what you need? That's normal.
copy.body: In-house graphic design, file setup and conversion, color correction, proofs, imposition & custom work — tell us what you need.

copy.headline: Quick-turn, short-run, full-color.
copy.body: On our Digital presses — standard sheets up to 13×19½″, and long-sheet printing up to 51 inches for banners, book covers, and panoramic pieces.

copy.headline: Printing up to 50+″ wide.
copy.body: Posters, banners, signage, canvas and fine-art prints, with optional mounting and laminating. Trade show panels and banner stands. Larger rigid work handled through trusted production partners.

copy.headline: Cut, fold, stitch, bind, laminate.
copy.body: Cutting, folding, saddle stitch, coil and perfect binding, Wire-O, laminating, scoring, die cutting, round cornering, perforating — down to mounting on gator or foamcore.

copy.headline: Straight into the mail stream.
copy.body: List processing, addressing, presorting, and machine inserting — we can take your mailing from design to the post office in one shop.

copy.headline: Your brand. Their names. Zero back-and-forth.
copy.body: Private ordering portals for companies that print with us. Your templates stay locked to your brand — your people type their details, watch the proof update live, and approve.

copy.headline: Small shop. Deep bench.
copy.body: Your job is run by people who've spent their careers in production — prepress through bindery — and who check the work at every step.

finale.headline: Tell us what you're making.
finale.body: Get a quote and describe it in plain words — we'll figure out the rest together. Call (503) 222-2942 or email sendjob@citygi.com. Nonprofits: ask about our nonprofit pricing.
